item.description: 💖 requested!! Positive affirmations (some Christian) + personal attention including brushing, skincare, and makeup. 0:00-11:12 English You were made in God’s image Everything meant to be is bound to stay If it’s your calling it will keep calling What if it all works out? - Routine is medicine - Good sleep is medicine - Consistency is medicine - Safe relations is medicine - Laughter is medicine - Movement is medicine - Fresh air is medicine - Good smells is medicine - Music is medicine - Touch is medicine - Good food is medicine - A smile is medicine - Love is medicine Own lane Own race Own pace Do small things with great love Trust God’s timing Nothing can stop God from loving you Start with Jesus Stay with Jesus End with Jesus I will trust God I will not overthink I will not worry I will not stress out I will believe the best I will trust God’s timing I will rest in him I am enough I am capable I am stronger than yesterday I am kind to myself I am confident in my skills and gifts Working towards my goals consistently is easy for me I see my goals clearly I am grateful for each moment I am blessed with I have so much to look forward to 11:13-18:36 Spanish Fuiste creado/a a imagen de Dios. Todo lo que está destinado a ser, permanecerá. Si es tu vocación, seguirá llamándote. ¿Y si todo sale bien? La rutina es medicina Dormir bien es medicina La constancia es medicina Las relaciones seguras son medicina La risa es medicina El movimiento es medicina El aire fresco es medicina Los buenos olores son medicina La música es medicina El contacto es medicina La buena comida es medicina Una sonrisa es medicina El amor es medicina Tu propio carril Tu propia carrera Tu propio ritmo Haz las cosas pequeñas con gran amor. Confía en el tiempo de Dios. Nada puede impedir que Dios te ame.
